The '''Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor''' was a short-range light [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:BladeOfDorin-TCWIV.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]'' docked with a [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|Syliure-31 hyperdrive ring]].]]

The Delta-7B was manufactured by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]], and initially saw use as Delta-7's were lost in battle. The main difference between the Delta-7B and its predecessor the [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7]], was a relocation of the [[Astromech socket/Legends|astromech socket]] from the port (left) side of the starfighter, to just in front of the cockpit. This, along with a slightly-enlarged center-[[Hull/Legends|hull]], would allow for a full-size [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] to be used instead of the truncated units<ref name="DB Jedi starfighter">{{DB|starship|delta7|Jedi starfighter}}</ref>—such as the [[R4-P astromech droid|R4-P]] or the [[R3-D]]—seen in the earlier-model Delta-7. Also like the [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7]], the Delta-7B had 4 twin laser-cannons (2 above the "triangular"-shaped hull, and 2 right below the "upper" cannons, on the underside of the hull). It also typically depended on other spacecraft or an [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|external hyperdrive ring]] for faster-than-light travel.

==History==
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] flew at least [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|one yellow and gray Delta-7B]] that was damaged during the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]] and later recovered. The fighter was also present for the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], and Skywalker later piloted the vessel during the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], where it was seemingly destroyed by a monstrous [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]]. Usually flying alongside as his wingmate was [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who used a [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|red, green, and white Delta-7B]].

[[File:Delta7B-SWE.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The yellow-painted design of Anakin Skywalker's customized Delta-7B]]
[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] flew a Delta-7B with an almost [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|identical color scheme]] to his previous Delta-7 and utilized the same astromech droid, [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]].

[[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] flew a [[Barriss Offee's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B]] alongside Ahsoka Tano during the beginning of the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. It had the same hull graphic design as Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B, just with a different color scheme.

[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] flew a [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|Delta-7B]] during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] and later during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]].

[[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] piloted a [[Saesee Tiin's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B]] during a [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|mission]] to rescue a group of [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|prisoners being held]] on [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]]. It had the same hull graphic design as Ahsoka Tano's Delta-7B, just with a different color scheme.

[[File:Delta7Bengines-TCWs3BR3.png|thumb|right|250px|The sublight engines on Adi Galia's Delta-7B]]
[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] flew a Delta-7B named the ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]'', which had the same color scheme as his later Delta-7.

[[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] piloted a [[Adi Gallia's Jedi Starfighter/Legends|Delta-7B]] with the same hull design as Plo Koon's ''Blade of Dorin'' in a red color scheme. She piloted this fighter during the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|Battle of Lola Sayu]].

[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] flew a [[Kit Fisto's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|maroon starfighter with a light green emblem on the hull]].

[[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli's]] [[Luminara Unduli's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B]] had a green and gray color scheme.

[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] flew his [[Mace Windu's Jedi fighter/Legends|Delta-7B]] with his astromech [[R8-B7/Legends|R8-B7]] to check on the wreckage of the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']]. When the bounty hunters came looking for Windu's body, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] took Windu's fighter to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to replay a message.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Hasbro]] originally identified this fighter as a "Delta-2,"<ref name="Hasbro">{{Rebelscum|url=SDCC08/Hasbro/presentation/image67.asp|text=Hasbro promotional image}}</ref> but ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' provided the Delta-7B designation.

The Hasbro toy version can split in two parts, with the pilot section heavily resembling the [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]].
